text_block_list.text:
At a café on my day off, I spotted Satono 
Diamond and Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Hello!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, today, McQueen-san brought me to a 
shop that she recommends!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Please order whatever catches your fancy. 
No matter what you choose from this menu, 
you cannot go wrong."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Um...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! This shop offers 129 
different varieties of sweets...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? "A special honor awaits those who 
conquer the entire menu...!?" What could 
this be referring to?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T-That's... strictly hearsay, but I heard 
that whoever conquers the entire menu is 
bestowed the title of "Maestro."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Although, it seems no one has ever 
actually claimed that title yet...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yes— Except for McQueen (currently on a 
diet), that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How do you know that?! Wait, why are you 
even here?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A title held solely by McQueen-san... Oh, 
how utterly fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to take on the challenge! To 
start, the first 20 items from the left 
side of the menu!
choice_data_list: You're over your calorie limit, you know.
Want to give it a shot?

Do you want to try taking on the 
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to take on the challenge! To 
start, the first 20 items from the left 
side of the menu!
choice_data_list: You're over your calorie limit, you know.
Want to give it a shot?

Do you want to try taking on the 
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That may be true, but... Ugh, is it really 
not okay...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"That is the wiser choice. Thanks to 
taking on that mortal struggle that 
spanned ten days, my weight has—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*ahem* *ahem*. Delicious food is best 
enjoyed in moderation. Now then, tell me 
what you'd like—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I recommend the katsudon, pickled 
cucumbers, and clam soup.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see... In that case, let's go with that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"We don't sell anything like that! Gold 
Ship-san, please go home!"

Afterward, Satono Diamond ended up 
ordering the sweets Mejiro McQueen 
recommended. ...Taking calories into 
account, of course.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will definitely catch up to 
McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hau... I-It's no use... It feels like my 
entire body is suffocating in sweet 
aroma...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It seems I'm still not quite on 
McQueen-san's level...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed that is true. After all, even I 
required ten whole days to conquer it. 
Consuming twenty dishes in a single 
sitting is simply...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, damn, that's pretty impressive. Good 
for you, McQueen, looks like you've got a 
successor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Successor to what?! Ahh, my mistakes have 
even carried over to the younger 
generation...!

Satono Diamond has consumed a massive 
amount of calories! Will she become the 
second "Maestro" just like this... !?
